# Security Policy / 安全政策

## Reporting a vulnerability / 报告安全漏洞

**Please do not report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues.**
/ **请不要通过公开 Issue 报告安全漏洞。**

Use GitHub's **Private vulnerability reporting** (Security tab of this repository →
"Report a vulnerability") to submit a report privately. You can also reach the
maintainer by email: 1550400341@qq.com.

请使用本仓库 **Security 标签页的 "Report a vulnerability"**(GitHub 私密安全报告功能)
私下提交;也可通过邮件联系维护者:1550400341@qq.com。

Please include / 请附上:

- Affected version / 受影响版本
- Reproduction steps / 复现步骤
- Impact / 影响评估

## Response / 响应

Reports will be acknowledged and investigated; fixes will be released as soon as
practical, with credit to the reporter by default.

报告会被尽快确认与调查;修复将以新版本发布,默认对报告者致谢。
